title: Affine lisse stratifications from a constructible open restriction and zero complement
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. On the small pro-etale site of any scheme $Y$, let $B_Y$ be the sheaf of locally finite continuous $\Omega$-valued functions and let $\mathcal A(Y)=\operatorname{Mod}(B_Y)$, with lisse and constructible as in [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], applied on $Y$ itself rather than its geometric fibre. Thus lisse means locally $B^{\oplus r}$ on a pro-etale cover, with finite rank allowed to vary among covering members, and constructible means locally on $Y$ a finite constructible locally closed partition with lisse restrictions. For a morphism $f:Y'\to Y$, use the actual module pullback $f^*N=B_{Y'}\otimes_{f^{-1}B_Y}f^{-1}N$, with the coefficient map given by precomposition of functions.

Let $X$ be a scheme and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $M\in\mathcal A(U)$ be constructible, and let $N\in\mathcal A(X)$ have an isomorphism $j^*N\cong M$. Assume $g^*N\cong0$ for every scheme morphism $g:W\to X$ whose image misses $j(U)$. For every affine open immersion $v:V\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], form $D=U\times_XV$ with projections $a:D\to V$, $b:D\to U$, and let $z:Z\hookrightarrow V$ be the reduced closed subscheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme] supported on $V\setminus a(D)$. Then $D$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]; the images of $a$ and $z$ are constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset], disjoint and cover $V$. There is a finite constructible locally closed stratification $D=\coprod_rD_r$ [def-constructible-stratification] on which $b^*M$ is lisse. With $i_r:D_r\hookrightarrow D$, the actual module pullbacks satisfy $i_r^*a^*v^*N\cong i_r^*b^*M$ and $z^*v^*N\cong0$. There is a finite constructible locally closed stratification of $V$ on which $v^*N$ is lisse, hence $N$ is constructible on $X$. This includes $D=\varnothing$, $Z=\varnothing$, and $M=0$: empty strata may be omitted and a zero restriction is lisse of rank zero.

proof.text: Both pullback projections are open immersions by base-change stability. The projection a : D → V is quasi-compact by base-change stability of quasi-compactness. Apply QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace to a and affine V to make D compact, and quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated to a and affine V to make D quasi-separated. No separation hypothesis on X is used.

The already proved Scheme.Hom.isConstructible_range applies to the quasi-compact open immersion a. Its complement is constructible by Topology.IsConstructible.compl. For the local-constructibility argument take the actual vanishingIdeal subscheme of the closed complement C. Its closed immersion and range C are supplied directly by Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.IdealSheaf.Subscheme (range_subschemeι and coe_support_vanishingIdeal); neither the uniqueness nor the affine ideal description of the reduced-induced-closed-subscheme theorem is required. For any prescribed z with range C, IsCompl follows by rewriting with its range equation.

The private proved finite_stratification_of_stratified enumerates its finite index type with Fintype.equivFin: the strata are the immersion ranges, locally closed by Scheme.Hom.isLocallyClosed_range; the unique-cover property gives their union and pairwise disjointness, including an empty index type. The comparison c : a* v* N ≅ b* M is (adicUpperStarCompIso l pullback.condition.symm).app N followed by b*e. Mapping c along every stratum gives the required stratum comparisons.

proof.text: The image of $v z:Z\to X$ misses $j(U)$: if $v(z(t))$ belonged to $j(U)$, then $z(t)$ would belong to $v^{-1}(j(U))=O$, contradicting $z(t)\in C$. Apply the hypothesis on $N$ to this particular morphism $g=v z$ to get $(v z)^*N\cong0$. The canonical pullback compositor therefore gives $z^*v^*N\cong0$. The zero module is lisse directly from the definition, using the identity pro-etale cover and $B_Z^{\oplus0}=0$; hence its isomorphic restriction $z^*v^*N$ is lisse of rank zero.

Apply the already proved native IsAdicStratifiedLisseSheaf.of_isCompl to a and z, transferring the stratification on b* M across c.symm and using the rank-zero lisse restriction on z. This is the source implementation of the planned composition-and-adjoin construction: its of_partition proof composes the strata immersions, transports the constructible images along the retrocompact open and the closed complement, and checks the unique-cover property. Enumerate the resulting finite family with the same private finite_stratification_of_stratified proof to obtain T.

The construction does not require any space, index type, stratum, or rank to be nonempty or positive; thus empty D, Z, V and M = 0 are covered.
